five_second.sells: Online art and manifesting courses (NeuroGraphica, Art of Manifesting Method) blending art, neuroscience and mindful practice
five_second.for_whom: people interested in creative self-development, wellness and spiritual growth
five_second.price_guess: unclear from the homepage, but felt like it would land somewhere in the $50-$300 range for a course

features_used.moment: I opened the menu to see where a facilitator directory might be listed, since the homepage itself had no obvious link.
I typed 'Spain' into the search by name/country/language box and it live-filtered to 0 facilitators found, confirming no one there.
I tapped the United Kingdom button and it correctly narrowed the list from 28 down to 3 facilitators.
I searched 'Garcia' and found Angelica Garcia Petersen, an AMM Facilitator who lists Spanish among her languages - a solid Spanish-sounding proxy for my workshop leader.

features_looked_for_but_missing: a Spain option among the quick-filter country buttons
a way to tell which specific method (NeuroGraphica vs Art of Manifesting) each facilitator is certified to teach
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: the live search box in the facilitator directory that filtered results instantly as I typed, without needing to press Find
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: the 'All' filter button didn't clear my typed search text, so results stayed stuck at 0 until I manually erased what I'd typed

friction.moment: Clicking 'All' right after searching 'Spain' didn't reset the search box - it still showed 0 facilitators found until I cleared the text myself.

Spain isn't one of the quick-filter country buttons (only UK, USA, Canada, Taiwan, Hellas/Greece, Saudi Arabia, Hong Kong, New Zealand were offered), so I could only check it by typing the country name into search.

delight.moment: The directory searched live as I typed - no need to hit Find - and it actually worked like a real directory with names, locations, languages, and contact links for each person.

what_earned_it: a genuinely searchable and filterable directory instead of a static dumped list
real facilitator profiles with their own websites, social links, and emails, not placeholder text
the search accurately matched on country and language details, not just name
trust.what_it_would_take: add Spain (and more countries) as quick filter buttons, and make the 'All' button actually clear any typed search text

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's an online art-and-manifesting course site by Anna Denning that actually has a real, searchable directory of certified facilitators around the world.
brand_recall.product_remembered: Art of Manifesting Method course / facilitator certification
brand_recall.price_remembered: not sure - I never got to a price page, I only used the facilitator directory
